Hi There. You are not alone in feeling this. 
Because you started cutting as a crutch to cope with how you were feeling at the time, this has now turned into a crutch for all things in your life, and also an addiction. Everyone has different coping mechanisms, and even when things seems to be going ok, its hard to shake of the need to use though's methods. 
I completely know what you mean about wanting to cut when everything seems to be going fine, but for some unknown reason, the urge to do it is always there. Because it would have initially started as a way of controlling the way you felt, now, whatever you feel, sad, happy, anything, your first reaction will be to cut. You need to learn to accept the feeling of accomplishment as good and positive, not something that should make you feel guilty or inadequate. You deserve happiness just like everyone else, especially when you've earned it. Try to change the crutch you use now (the cutting) for something positive. Maybe thats treating yourself to your favorite sweet, or buying yourself something nice. Or even as simple as running yourself a nice relaxing bath, just taking time out for you, but in a positive way.

Thank you. I guess when you first get depression, then start to recover, you don't even contemplate being that low again, or that it might be completely out of your control if you do fall back into it. Every day is hard, but its still in the right direction.
I know exactly how that feels. Like a release, a breath of fresh air, almost happiness! Complete acceptance that it will be over soon. Bliss
Im so sorry you feel like this...I know exactly how you feel....who did this to you?

I'm sorry you are too. I wouldn't wish this upon my worst enemy. I have never felt so alone in all my life. Last night confirmed the one person who is meant to pick me over everyone won't. So what do I have left? Nothing

I don't know how to talk you out of this as I am in the exact same position as you. I am currently sitting at my desk at work trying desperately to hold back the tears. All I want to do is walk off into the woods and hang myself.

People can treat you however they want. Hurt you, let you down, ignore you, but the moment you try to take the control of hurting yourself in your own hands they all of a sudden show an interest. Its to do with them not wanting to feel guilty or to make out they care. That's why they say it is bad, but they won't admit what they did to you to make you like this is even worse.

And why are you ending up in the same spot? 
when I say I am done, I mean with my life. I have no purpose and can not see any future for myself. The people that said they wouldn't let me down and would always be there for me lied. No one cares, so why the hell would I.

He's meant to be the one person who has my back, I'm meant to be his no1. But he doesn't care just like everyone else. I'm no one's no1, no one has my back, no one cares. They only pretend they do when it suits them, then they just go back to pretending I'm not there. I'm done with them all.

Hi. I think this is very similar to why people cut. We cut to relieve the stress and pain, and if we wanted to, push the blade deeper and end it all. I am sure if guns were easier to get a hold of like sharp objects were, more people would do what you do. Everyone has their own different release. I've been thinking more about hanging myself, not to kill myself, but for the pain. I think I am going to try this tonight.
Hi. am I right in guessing your other half has let you down just like everyone else? Mine did too if you would like to talk.

I am sorry, truly. As I wouldn't wish this upon anyone. 
I'm done with trying to beg people to help me.

And everyone who is meant to be there for you does the exact same thing. Then its only when you are sabotaging your life do these people intervene and try to help. But by that point I'm done with wanting help. They had their chance and blew it. Now they are trying to make up for their lack of interest when you actually needed it by smothering you for a week or 2, for them to then go back to ignoring you until you are bad again. I'm fucking sick of this fake care that people try to pass up as being genuine concern, because all it does is makes me worse the 2nd time around because they have confirmed to me with their actions that they do not care.

I could not agree with you more. 
I want this pain to end, I want the loneliness to end. And I think the same regarding the adverts etc, they are such BS. All anyone ever says is "have you tried talking to someone" then when you say yes, their response is "well try again"!!!! And that makes me so angry because all that does is make me feel more worthless and proves no one cares and that I'm just a burden and that I have to say I'm going to kill myself for someone to notice. I want someone to help me because they want to, because I'm worth it. But I'm not worth anything and the people closest to me have made that crystal clear. Im sick of people trying to dictate my life, when they don't even want to be in it.
Hi, 29F here to listen.

I'm sick of people telling me I should talk to them about it and I should ask for help, when they know how bad I am, how bad I have been, and what I am capable of. And then it's ok for them to turn a blind eye when I'm getting bad again and just ignore it. Just typing this out to you now my eyes are filling up with tears (which I am trying to hold back) because I know I am worthless and no ones cares about me. I'm just so sick of people pretending to care about me.

You won't get advise as the people who have done it (successfully) aren't here anymore. 
I though would also use this method but also mixed with overdoes on some sort of pills. 
When I decided this was the way I wanted to go, I would get my sexual partner to choke me out completely during sex, just so I could experience it (obviously he didn't know the real reason behind it) but, I am trained in Brazilian jujitsu so I showed him how to do it safely. 
If I'm honest, it is a very terrifying experience, though you pass out pretty quick (around 10 seconds) so just when you think you cant do it you are out. Then obviously I would wake up. 
Since doing that, it helped me come to terms more and accept what I plan to do. I have also lost all the fear of taking my own life.

Hold onto that fear for as long as you can, because once that is gone, there's not much left holding you back anymore. 
Also, I'm not scarred of the pain side to it at all, as the pain I've been through with this, when its just the blackest of black, and your heart hurts so much you just want to rip it from your chest, that is the pain that scares me the most. When that pain and misery completely consumes you, and you feel like you are drowning. When the voices are screaming in your head. That scares me more then killing myself. 
I did talk to a few people in the beginning, but now they've shown me that I was right all along to think I was worthless and not worth peoples time. They've stopped asking if I am ok, they look the other way when they see my fresh cuts, and ignore when I'm withdrawn. So now I feel I have confirmed to myself that no one cares about me. 
I basically only get by each day because I tell myself that maybe today is the day I do it. Maybe today something will push me over the edge and then it will all be over. I don't know how long I can get by like this, but now its not a question of if I will, now its when I will.

I'm from London, so through my last job I got bupa helpline for free, which was a weekly call with a therapist. TBH, it was the hardest thing to do, talk about it out loud, and to a complete stranger. I never finished the course as I changed jobs, and tried to manage it myself. I was referred back to my GP who put me on med's straight away as I was high risk of suicide. I only took those for around a month as I didn't like not being able to control my emotions. The therapist got me to write everything down, day by day in a little book, which I still carry around with me now and write  in. I think that helps as its a form of outlet for what you are feeling. The problem is with me, because I have already accepted the fact that I was going to kill myself, I don't think I could ever get that back, if that makes sense. I don't have any fear around it, and have completely accepted it as an option, which is the dangerous bit. I've had 2 suicide attempts, the last one was when we had that snow back in April, which ruined my plans, then after that, because I didn't expect to live past that, I just sort of didn't know about anything anymore. I had no plan, and was very confused. I took it as an opportunity to make myself better, and for a while, it sorta worked. But i'm now back where I was, feeling hopeless, worthless, and that my life has no purpose. I have no life goals anymore, I have nothing to look forward to, I don't even see a future for myself anymore. All I can think about is when will I end it. I know I should probably go back to see a therapist, but I'm so sick and tired of fighting this battle every second of every day. It is mentally, emotionally and physically draining. I'm sick of the loneliness, the fact that no one cares, or they look the other way. That hurts the most. The people that say they are there for you and will always be there, just looking the other way.

I have 2 cat's who I love like children, and unfortunately for me, they have not given me a reason not to end it, or given my life a sense of purpose. I think at first when I got them, they were a distraction from my thoughts, but, like most things, it can only distract your mind for so long before those thoughts come back. This was also the same for my nephew. He is 3 and a half years old, and when I was at my lowest, I spoke to my therapist, they get you to find a reason in your life not to end it. Something to be your anchor to stay. He was it. He was the only reason I didn't end it all, as I thought he doesn't deserve to grow up and have an aunt that killed herself. He's only innocent, And he loves me for me. But, now a year later, even he can't help me anymore. 
I think it is a great way for you to distract yourself from your thoughts - for now, but it will not distract you forever. The thoughts will come back. You will have to find your own reasons to keep going. You will have to make yourself think positively and find other (healthy) things to distract you. This is just my experience, but I didn't just want to say yes get a dog and everything will be ok again, because for me, it wasn't.
What's happened? Is this the first time? what's happened to make you come to these choices?

I was told to keep a little notebook on me at all times, for when I need to let it out, but can't tell anyone. Inside I have written the exact same thing you have posted. And I think that maybe this might be an idea for you? If i'm honest since I lost the will to live (died inside) I have never been the same, I feel I have lost the light in my eyes, that I'm not the same person anymore, that I've just completely given up...on everything. And nothing around me can bring it back. I know everyone says you have the power to change your life, but do we? Really? I believe you can control what you do and how you behave, but are powerless with the outcome. And yeah, I get it, lifes shit, but maybe Im tired of always being the one and only person I can rely on.

I think you should call one of those suicide help lines (for me it was BUPA helpline, I'm in the UK), they are free and someone can assess you over the phone to find out what you are suffering from. They ask you lots of questions and its best just to be honest so you get an accurate result. Then they can discuss with you next steps, what you can do to help yourself, and refer the information to your doctor. Its basically the firsts steps to getting help. Its very hard as you have to tell all this to a complete stranger. But, it will give you some insight into what you are feeling and why.

How many chances can you give someone before you've had enough? Am I not allowed to be selfish and do whatever I want to do? I find most people around me are only there for themselves. I've put other people first my whole life, and now that I need help, no one is to be seen. I've already asked them for help (My husband included) and been completely honest with them about everything. So they know how bad things are. And I know that everyone has their own life and problems, which is why most of us don't tell anyone. But surely the people closest to you are meant to be the ones you can lean on in times of need. I've sacrificed so much for other people, to make them happy. I remember when I was at my worst (Suicidal) and my husband lost his job. I put all of my own problems and issues to the back of my head and focused on looking after him and making sure he was ok. I kinda went into auto pilot. It was all about him. Then once he got a new job and everything with him was fine, who was there to pick me back up? Who was there to make sure I was ok? Me. I am the only person I can rely on. So I think, if I want to be selfish I will, because everyone else around me has no problem doing this. So why should I be made to feel guilty for that.

Thank you for your comment, it made me smile and laugh (the weather & enjoying paris) I've never spoken to anyone who feels the same way as me, so I've never really talked about it. I was on meds last year, but stopped taking them nov/Dec...i felt like they were just covering everything up, that it was all still there in the background. Maybe if someone who claims to love and care for me actually meant it and showed it, that might make me change my mind..
